modelRouting.routingRationale: Deterministic query port over frozen graph/store shapes.

objective: Land one bounded native query owner over existing Blueprint generations: exact-first resolution, search, recall/neighborhood, path, impact, & task briefing without duplicate graph/index/storage/ranking authority.

preexistingOwnedBytes.disposition: read-only public GraphGeneration shape + exact donor identity body; file qualifiedName uses repository-relative path
read-only lossless Generation shape; formatted frozen bytes

sourcePortPolicy.atomOwnership: BPT-023 seed resolution; BPT-027 acquisition caps; BPT-028 search; BPT-029 target resolution; BPT-030 neighborhood; BPT-031 path; BPT-032 impact; BPT-041 briefing

integrationSeam.requiredSignature: pub fn execute_query(generation: &GraphGeneration, request: &BlueprintRequest, context: &RequestContext) -> Result<Value, BlueprintError>
integrationSeam.wiring: pub mod query; re-export execute_query only if consumers require root export

acceptance: preserve raw requested seed/target before normalization & in every result/omission receipt
resolution tiers distinct exact/case_folded/fuzzy/unresolved with explicit resolved/ambiguous/low_confidence/unresolved state; same-tier ambiguity abstains
optional index only proposes candidates; stale/missing/incomplete accelerator broadens to full authoritative graph scan
caps bind actual acquisition work: seeds/depth/fanout/nodes/edges/paths/path length/candidate count/bytes/deadline/cancellation; report omitted/capped counts
deterministic cycle-safe neighborhood/path traversal with complete ordered node+edge evidence; traversal completion never implies target resolution
impact separates known/possible/unresolved_dynamic/not_observed & never claims semantic completeness

task briefing projects anchors/alternatives/source-signature/owner/component/callers/callees/tests/impact/config/governing claims/derived constraints/freshness/generation/omissions without creating facts
generation mismatch/stale source fails closed or returns typed suppressed/partial state, never old-fresh
tests cover exact/case/fuzzy ambiguity, seed survival under full top-k, acquisition caps, cycle, path miss, dynamic impact uncertainty, stale index fallback, cancellation/deadline
